subject: general
question:
Find out the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

LV _ J _ VFJ T _ GJ XVH _ BV _ J
solution:
Given : LV _ J _ VFJ T _ GJ XVH _ BV _ J

By checking options :

 
• EPVJI → LV __**E**__ J __**P**__ VFJ T __**V**__ GJ XVH __**J**__ BV __**I**__ J → (It follows the pattern o [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8403e501dcd71dfd8afb94253c911a1c8eed3f7f9a6540488c172ff6763f8b55.png] 
 
• DVJLE → LV __D__ J __V__ VFJ T __J__ GJ XVH __L__ BV __E__ J → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• DBRPE → LV **__D__** J __B__ VFJ T **__R__** GJ XVH __P__ BV __E__ J → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• EJBLR → LV __E__ J __J__ VFJ T __B__ GJ XVH __L__ BV __R__ J → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "**EPVJI**" is the correct answer.
